metadata.title: Palantir Stock Leads August Rally -- Nvidia, Salesforce and Super Micro Jump

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Palantir Technologies (NASDAQ:PLTR) paced gains across technology stocks in August, with shares rising 51% as investors responded to strong second-quarter results and an upbeat full-year outlook.
Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) followed with a 39.95% advance, while Super Micro Computer (NASDAQ:SMCI) climbed 31.27%. The moves came as software and artificial intelligence stocks attracted renewed investor interest during the month.
Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) also delivered a solid August, gaining 8%. Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) rose 4%, while Meta Platforms (META) added 3% and Apple (AAPL) increased 2%. The broader technology sector gained 6.36% during the month.
The rally was not uniform. Western Digital (WDC) dropped 17%, while Datadog (DDOG) declined 11%, showing that strong quarterly results did not always translate into higher share prices as investor expectations remained elevated.
For Palantir, the August surge underscores strong market momentum, but the sharp gain also leaves the stock more exposed to valuation and expectation risks.
